Build a realtime Gouraud-shaded rotating cube in a single self-contained file
`effect_gouraud_shaded_cube_openrouter-upstage-solar-pro4_01.html` using Canvas 2D only (no WebGL, no external libraries).

Implement a minimal 3D pipeline: vertices, rotation matrices, perspective projection, and backface
culling. Split faces into triangles and do per-vertex lighting (Lambert), then rasterize the
triangles with color interpolation across each face (Gouraud shading). Add a moving light source,
a wireframe toggle (W), and pause (P). Display the current FPS.

Deliver the one file `effect_gouraud_shaded_cube_openrouter-upstage-solar-pro4_01.html`.

{"edit_description": "Create a single self-contained HTML file named effect_gouraud_shaded_cube_openrouter-upstage-solar-pro4_01.html that renders a realtime Gouraud-shaded rotating cube on Canvas 2D with the following pipeline:

- Define 8 cube vertices and 6 faces (each face split into 2 triangles = 12 triangles total).
- Per-frame: apply rotation matrices (X and Y), then perspective projection with configurable FOV and depth.
- Backface culling: discard triangles whose projected vertices are ordered clockwise (or whose face normal points away from camera) before rasterizing.
- Per-vertex Lambert lighting: compute face normal per triangle, light direction from a moving light source (orbiting around the cube), compute diffuse factor per vertex, and assign RGB.
- Gouraud rasterization: for each visible triangle, compute bounding box, and for each pixel inside, interpolate the three vertex colors using barycentric coordinates, then fill with the interpolated color. Use integer math where sensible for speed.
- Wireframe toggle (press W): draw triangle edges on top of the shaded raster when enabled.
- Pause toggle (press P): stop/start rotation and animation.
- Moving light source: animate the light position in a circle/ellipse around the cube so the shading visibly changes over time.
- Display current FPS in the corner (compute delta time between frames, smooth the FPS value).
- Canvas fills the window; handle resize. Use requestAnimationFrame loop.
- Style: dark background, visible cube, readable FPS text. No external libraries, no WebGL.

Write the complete file.", "path": "effect_gouraud_shaded_cube_openrouter-upstage-solar-pro4_01.html"}
